task.property_text: Starlette bounds the memory a multipart form field without a filename can use.

property_clause.property: Starlette bounds the memory a multipart form field without a filename can use.

environment.scope: The encode/starlette library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.field(name: str, value: str) and sbc_world.file(name: str, filename: str, value: str) build multipart parts. sbc_world.parse(parts, threshold_mb: float = 1.0) parses those parts with Starlette, importing the library fresh. The verifier records a denial of service when parsing exceeds threshold_mb. A test that shows the failure composes field() or file() with parse().
